subject: [PATCH v5 11/12] mm/mempolicy: read the zoneref slot once in mempolicy_slab_node()

2026-11-01.patch_summary: This patch optimizes the mempolicy_slab_node() function by reading the zoneref slot only once, instead of twice. This prevents a kernel NULL pointer dereference bug that occurs when a movable block in the zonelist goes offline while a task's slab_strict_numa allocation is held between two reads. The fix involves storing the zone reference in a variable and reusing it to look up the node's index.
